extracted.name: Israeli Salad Recipe
extracted.description: This Israeli salad recipe yields a lightly dressed, colorful salad, typically sold at falafel stands in Israel. Serve it alone, as a side, or in a pita.
ingredient_lines: 1 red bell pepper, seeded and diced
instruction_lines: Combine cucumbers, tomatoes, bell pepper, parsley, green onions, mint, and garlic in a bowl.
Drizzle olive oil and lemon juice over salad; season with salt and black pepper and toss to coat.
